about_the_game:
EVERY RACE IS DIFFERENT.

This is Rattus VELOCITAS, an arcade racing game where Rats with Jet-powered hoverbikes compete for pole position in procedurally generated race courses! Collect items to give yourself an advantage or take out the competition in this high speed rodent frenzy!

ABOUT THE DEMO VERSION.

The demo version only has the Desert race environment and the Quick Race feature, with winrate-based difficulty adjustment turned on by default. Replays can be viewed after finishing a race but not saved. In-game settings such as Game Volume, Graphics settings and Controller Rumble settings are adjustable, just like the Full Game.

Other players can join by pressing the equivalent START button on their controller before Player 1 selects "Join Rat Race" to start a race. 

No save file is generated by the Demo Version of the game.


*Please note that multiple game controllers, including Xbox 360, Xbox One, Dualshock 4(R) or DualSense(R) controllers are required for Splitscreen multiplayer mode. Performance depending on your PC's hardware configuration may be reduced in Splitscreen. Online mode requires a Broadband internet connection with 2mbps of upload bandwidth to operate correctly. Mobile networks are not officially supported.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 860 or AMD equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 640 / AMD Radeon R7 240
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Support for NVIDIA Kepler based graphics cards on Linux ended in September 2024, it is highly recommended to upgrade to a Maxwell architecture graphics card or equivalent AMD graphics card to ensure stability of your Linux gaming system.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 or AMD equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
